privacy-policy.html:
Privacy Policy

1. Introduction

AGEBETTER SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED (“Company”, “we”, “our”, “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and safeguard your information when you use our website, services or purchase products. It complies with applicable Indian laws including the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the IT (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.

2. Consent

By using our website or services, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy and consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your information as described.

3. Information We Collect

  • Personal details (name, contact info, address, date of birth, gender, etc.)
  • Order and transactional data
  • Health-related data you voluntarily provide
  • Usage data such as device info, IP addresses, browsing behavior
  • Information from third parties such as social media platforms and marketing partners

4. Use of Your Information

We use your data to:

  • Process and deliver orders
  • Communicate about your account, orders, and services
  • Improve our website, products, and services through analytics
  • Conduct marketing and promotional communications (with your consent)
  • Comply with legal and regulatory obligations
  • Prevent fraud, investigate violations, and ensure security
  • Conduct research, user feedback, and customer service improvement
  • Provide personalized offers and tailored content

5. Sharing Your Information

Your personal data may be shared:

  • With trusted service providers for payment processing, delivery, and order fulfillment
  • With legal or regulatory authorities as required by law
  • Within our group companies for business purposes under secure confidentiality
  • With third parties only as anonymized or aggregated data that does not identify you

6. Data Security

We use physical, technical, and administrative safeguards to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no system is completely secure over the internet.

7. Cookies and Tracking

Cookies and similar technologies help us improve user experience and analyze traffic. You can modify your browser settings to refuse cookies which may affect website functionality.

8. User Rights

You may access, update, correct, or request deletion of your personal information by contacting us. You may also opt out of marketing communications as per applicable laws.

9. Children’s Privacy

Our services are intended for users above 18 years. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. Parents or guardians are responsible for minors’ actions online.

10. Data Retention

We retain personal data only as long as necessary for business or legal purposes, after which it is securely deleted or anonymized.

11. Grievance Redressal

You may contact our Grievance Officer for privacy concerns at:

  • Name: Neha Zade
  • Email: neha@betterhood.in 
  • Phone: +91 9930532539
  • Address: 1st Floor, SPD Plaza, 5th Block, Koramangala Industrial Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034


We commit to acknowledge your complaint within 48 hours and resolve it within 30 days in accordance with applicable laws.

12. Changes to Privacy Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Updates will be posted on our website with an effective date. Continued use after changes indicates consent.

User Security and Payment Disclaimer

  • AGEBETTER SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED will never ask for OTPs, passwords, CVVs or other sensitive payment info via phone, SMS, email or any unverified communication channel.
  • Customers should only enter payment data on the official, secure checkout page. Beware of phishing attempts from imposters claiming to be betterhood representatives.
  • Report any suspicious requests or communications to care@betterhood.in or +91 8484805885 immediately.
  • Customers are responsible for safeguarding their login credentials and should notify betterhood promptly if they suspect account compromise.

return-policy.title: Return Policy
return-policy.html:
Return Policy

  1. Return Window

Customers can request a return, replacement, or exchange within 7 days of delivery.

To be eligible for a return:

  • The product should be in good condition.
  • The product should include original packaging where possible.
  • The product should not show signs of heavy use, damage, stains, or misuse.

Returned products will be inspected before processing refunds or exchanges.

  1. Free Size Exchange

For support products such as Back Support, Knee Support, Elbow Support, Wrist Support, and other braces, betterhood offers one free size exchange if the product does not fit properly.

Customers may try the product for fit and comfort, but the product should not show excessive wear or damage.

  1. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Product

If you receive a product that is:

  • Damaged during delivery
  • Defective
  • Incorrect item delivered

Please contact our support team within 48 hours of delivery.

After verification, our team will arrange a free replacement or refund.

Customers may be asked to share photos of the product and packaging for verification.

  1. Non-Returnable Products

For hygiene and safety reasons, certain products cannot be returned once opened unless they are damaged or defective.

These include:

  • Roll-ons, patches, lotions, creams, and other topical-use products
  • Products showing heavy usage, stains, or physical damage
  1. How to Request a Return or Exchange

To request a return or exchange, please contact our support team and provide the following details:

  • Order ID
  • Product name
  • Reason for return or exchange

Customers may be required to share product images or videos for verification before return approval.  Pickup will typically be arranged within 2–3 working days after approval.

  1. Return Shipping

Free return pickup will be provided in the following cases:

  • Damaged product
  • Incorrect product delivered
  • Approved size exchange

If a return is requested due to personal preference, change of mind, or an order placed by mistake, a nominal return fee may apply. This fee can vary based on location and logistics, and will be clearly communicated during the return approval process.

To make things easy, betterhood can arrange a doorstep pickup for you. The applicable return fee will be adjusted against your refund.

Alternatively, if you prefer, you may also choose to self-ship the product to our return address. Once we receive and verify the product, your return will be processed smoothly.

Repeated returns or misuse of the return policy may result in restrictions on future orders or returns.

  1. Refund Policy

Once the returned product is received and inspected, refunds will be processed.

  • Refunds are initiated within 5–7 business days after inspection.
  • Refunds will be credited to the original payment method used during purchase.

Depending on the bank or payment provider, it may take additional time for the amount to reflect in the account.  

  1. Cancellation Policy

Orders can be cancelled only before they are dispatched.

Once the order has been shipped, cancellation will no longer be possible. Customers may refuse the delivery or request a return after receiving the order.

  1. Customer Support

For any queries related to returns, replacements, or refunds, please contact our support team.

Email: care@betterhood.in

Phone no :-  +918484805885

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy

  1. Purpose
    AGEBETTER SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED is committed to providing a work environment that promotes equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants. This policy ensures that employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications and abilities without discrimination.
  2. Scope
    This policy applies to all employees, applicants, contractors, interns and any individuals associated with the Company.
  3. Policy Statement
  • We strictly prohibit discrimination, harassment, or victimization on the basis of race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, nationality, socioeconomic status or any other status protected by law.
  • Employment decisions including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, transfers, layoffs and termination will be made without discrimination.
  • Sexual harassment and any form of workplace harassment will not be tolerated.
  1. Responsibilities
  • The Human Resources team is responsible for implementing this policy, providing training, and handling grievances related to discrimination.
  • Supervisors and managers must ensure compliance with the EEO policy and promote a discrimination-free workplace.
  • Employees are expected to adhere to the policy and report any violations promptly to HR or the designated officer.
  1. Grievance Procedure
  • Any employee who believes they have been subjected to discrimination or harassment should report the matter immediately to the HR department or designated Grievance Officer.
  • Complaints will be investigated promptly and confidentially. Appropriate corrective measures will be taken.
  1. Enforcement and Consequences
  • Violations of this policy may lead to disciplinary action, including termination of employment.
  • No retaliation will be tolerated against employees who report discrimination in good faith.
  1. Legal Compliance
  • This policy complies with the Indian Constitution Articles 15 and 16, Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and other applicable laws.
  1. Communication and Review
  • This policy will be communicated to all employees during onboarding and periodically thereafter.
  • The policy will be reviewed and updated as necessary to comply with changes in legal requirements and company standards.

Violations and Reporting

  • Violations of this policy, regardless of whether an actual law has been violated will not be tolerated.
  • The Company will promptly, thoroughly and fairly investigate every issue that is brought to its attention in this area and will take disciplinary action, when appropriate, up to and including termination of employment.
  • Employees who believe they have been subjected to discrimination, harassment, or any violation of this policy are encouraged to report the matter immediately.
  • Reports can be made without fear of retaliation or victimization.
  • All complaints will be treated confidentially to the extent possible and investigated impartially.

Reporting Violations

For any questions, concerns, or to report suspected breaches regarding this policy, please contact our Grievance Officer:

  • Name: Neha Zade
  • Email: neha@betterhood.in 
  • Phone: +91 8484805885
